言.meaning: A little box at the bottom, and above it three lines and a dot rising like steam off a cup. That box is a mouth, and the lines are words floating out of it. Open up, and that's what you <kanji>say</kanji>.
言.on: A fan called <sound>Gen</sound> loves every word you say and shouts 'Again!'
言.kun: You taste the cold soup and say just one thing: '<sound>Eee</sound>-<sound>ooh</sound>!'

計.meaning: <part>speech</part> beside a <part>ten</part>: a general whispers ten short speeches to ten soldiers, one each. No soldier hears the others, so none of them knows the whole <kanji>plot</kanji>.
計.on: Step one of the plot: hide a file inside a birthday <sound>ca</sound>ke.
計.kun: Step two: hide in a <sound>hu</sound>t and fish a <sound>ca</sound>rp out of the castle moat.

長.meaning: Hair streams down from the top in three lines, a stroke for a walking stick, and a robe sweeps the ground. An old wizard whose hair, beard and robe have grown for a hundred years. Everything about him is <kanji>long</kanji>.
長.on: He ties back all that long hair with a tight <sound>cho</sound>ker.
長.kun: His beard is so long it trails through his <sound>na</sound>an and <sound>ga</sound>rlic at every meal.

夫.meaning: A <part>large</part> figure stands with arms wide, but this <part>person</part> has <part>two</part> crossbars instead of one: the top bar is a <part>lid</part> of a top hat, pinned on for the wedding. He's ready to say 'I do': the <kanji>husband</kanji>.
夫.on: Before the wedding he naps on a rolled-up <sound>fu</sound>ton and squashes his top hat.
夫.kun: At the wedding, the husband yelps a sharp '<sound>Ot</sound>!' as he backs into a <sound>to</sound>tem pole.

歯.meaning: A crocodile leans over an old <part>rice</part> <part>bucket</part>, gargling minty water. 'Don't swallow it!' the dentist shouts. '<part>Stop</part>!' The croc freezes, jaws wide open, and she polishes its fangs one by one until every sharp <kanji>tooth</kanji> sparkles.
歯.on: You brush your teeth using a knight's <sound>shi</sound>eld as a mirror.
歯.kun: '<sound>Ha</sound>!' you grin into the shiny shield, flashing every clean tooth.

札.meaning: A <part>zigzag</part> of string hangs from a <part>tree</part> branch, with a paper label on the end: 'Apples, two coins.' Every tree in the orchard wears one. It's a price <kanji>tag</kanji>.
札.on: Even the <sound>sats</sound>uma trees wear tags, one on every orange.
札.kun: The biggest tag hangs on a <sound>fu</sound>ton, and a <sound>du</sound>ck sits on top of it.

戻.meaning: Through a <part>door</part> stomps a <part>large</part> dog with muddy paws. You shoo it out. It trots straight back in. Every time, it will <kanji>revert</kanji> to the same spot on the rug.
戻.on: Behind the dog, a big <sound>ray</sound> glides back in through the door too, flapping its fins.
戻.kun: The dog comes back and mumbles '<sound>Mo</sound>…' through the toy <sound>do</sound>ll in its mouth.
